newsitem.title: GERMANY: CASS data should be available to forwarders - BSL.
newsitem.headline: CASS data should be available to forwarders - BSL.

text.p: HAMBURG, August 5 Reuter) - IATA air cargo sales statistics should be made available to forwarders and not issued only to airlines, a top German forwarder said.

Wolf-Dietrich von Helldorff ,air cargo committee chairman of German forwarders association BSL, said the Cargo Accounts Settlement System (CASS) figures should be distributed more widely than at present.
CASS data shows air cargo export sales in terms of revenue between forwarders and airlines as well as tonnage and other market data.
"I do not accept that data is only given to one side but not the other. It belongs to both sides and both should have the information," von Helldorff told air cargo journalists at a BSL briefing.
Forwarders should naturally not receive any commercially sensitive information on competitors but were entitled to obtain a market overview, he explained.
"I do not have a problem with a transparent representation of the market," he stated. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
